warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 2.50 (5.50); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.00 + 1.50 + 1.50 + 1.50 (7.50). Origin A1. Same main chains print on S-01, S-02, both S-03 views, A-07 (x) and A-08 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no usable text layer (legacy Thai font encoding) — every value read off the rendered page.

x dummies: 1'' (-0.50) and 1'''' (2.00) are structural (S-02 beams); 1' (-1.00), 2'' (4.00) and 3' (6.50) are roof edges from the S-03 chains; 1''' (1.00), 2' (3.833) and 2''' (4.666) are truss panel points (S-04) — every tick is a line per section 4 rule 4. Before-origin dummies share grid 1's prime sequence in reading order (1' = -1.00, 1'' = -0.50, then 1''' = 1.00, 1'''' = 2.00).

y dummies: A' (-1.00), D''' (7.00) and E' (8.50) are roof edges (S-03); the rest are truss panel points (S-04 T2/T3/T4). Where two trusses tick the same point they agree to the centimetre (A'' 1.00, A''' 2.00 on T2/T3/T4; B' 3.75 on T2/T3).

S-04 truss elevations (T1-T5) print no grid bubbles under their chains. Each chain was positioned from what is drawn on it and matched to the S-03 plan: T1 runs T3 (grid 1) to T2 (grid 2), 3 x 1.000 = 3.00 = grid 1-2; T2 (grid 2) has supports at 0 / 3.00 / 4.50 / 7.50 and T5 marked at 1.50, which only fits with E on the left (T5 sits on row D on S-03 view 2) — subtotals 3.00 | 1.50 | 3.00 = E-C, C-B, B-A; T3 (grid 1) supports at A, B, C, E, chain symmetric so direction does not matter; T4 (grid 3) has T5 on its left end (row D) and supports at D, B, A (footings at A3, B3, D3, none at C3); T5 runs T2 (grid 2) to T4 (grid 3) = 2.50. Lines that come only from these chains carry confidence 0.85 and a flag.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน. A-07 and A-08 print the same level column; its detail segments 0.36 + 3.00 + 0.75 + 0.68 = 4.79 against the printed total 4.78, and +4.78 - +4.11 = 0.67 against the printed 0.68 — a 0.01 rounding in the drawing, values kept as printed. Three levels share the label ระดับหลังคา, so their ids carry the value.

Footing depths (1.00 from ระดับดินเดิม to top of footing, 0.25 footing, 0.05 lean concrete, 0.05 sand) and truss depths (T1 1.474 = 0.670 + 0.804, T2 1.424, T3 0.620, T4 0.796, T5 0.746) are dimensions inside one element and stay on the elements (S-05 / S-04 files), not as z ticks.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus the building sections A-07/A-08 (for levels). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run.
